title: CAMEO discovers GST467, a phase-change material with double the optical contrast
summary: CAMEO, using Bayesian active learning and closed-loop X-ray measurements, identified the Ge4Sb6Te7 alloy in 19 experimental cycles (about 10 hours), selected from 177 compositions. GST467 showed twice the optical contrast of GST225 and was demonstrated in a phase-change memory device; the result concerns this library and application, not a commercial memory.
organization: NIST; University of Maryland, University of Washington, SLAC

evidence.tested: CAMEO ran a closed loop over 177 candidate compositions in 19 experimental cycles; GST467 was measured by X-ray diffraction, showed twice the optical contrast of the reference alloy, and was demonstrated in a phase-change memory device.
evidence.unknown: Long-term performance and larger-scale behavior are not discussed; the tenfold time reduction is an estimate, not a measured result.
evidence.ai_role: Closed-loop Bayesian active learning chose which compositions to measure next and ran the X-ray measurements.
